name: faceless-video-remotion
description: Remotion renderer for the faceless video generator — reads spec.json, outputs 1080x1920 MP4.

scripts.studio: npm run build-registry && npm run copy-spec && remotion studio
scripts.render: npm run build-registry && npm run copy-spec && remotion render Video out/video.mp4
scripts.bundle: npm run build-registry && npm run copy-spec && remotion bundle
